scientific_integrity: Finite exact checks corroborate the algebra; proofs of monotonicity, all-size sign transition, and asymptotics are analytical. The claim has undergone self-review only; literature coverage cannot establish absolute historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The optimization covers pairs of wheel spokes only, not rim-edge failures or weights; the first negative separation is exact by a closed finite sign test and localized asymptotically, not by a simpler integer formula.
title: Spoke-pair resistance interactions on wheel networks
